parameters.content:
## GEO Prompt Generator (n8n form version)
**Flow:** GEO Form > read site > Gemini 1 (profile, 3 opportunities, keywords) > save `opportunities` + `keywords` > Gemini 2 (write buyer prompts; may fail safely) > save `prompts` > results page.

**Share:** open the GEO Form node and copy the **Production URL**. No landing page, CORS or webhook setup needed.

**Setup:** 1) Run the Apps Script for tabs/headers. 2) Header Auth credential: `x-goog-api-key` = Gemini key. 3) Activate the workflow.

**Fallback:** if Gemini fails (e.g. 503 high demand, 429 limit), the OpenAI nodes (red/error branch) take over. Create a Header Auth credential `Authorization` = `Bearer sk-...` and select it on both OpenAI nodes.
